Class MoreCollectors

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.gaia.core.collect.MoreCollectors
public final class MoreCollectors extends Object
Collectors that Collectors does not provide.

  • Method Details

    • onlyElement

      public static <T> Collector<T,?,T> onlyElement()
      Returns a collector of the one element of a stream, which must contain exactly one. 
      User admin = users.stream().filter(User::isAdmin).collect(MoreCollectors.onlyElement());
      Type Parameters:
      T - the element type
      Returns:
      a collector of the only element
      Throws:
      NoSuchElementException - when collecting, if the stream is empty
      IllegalArgumentException - when collecting, if the stream has more than one element

    • toOptional

      public static <T> Collector<T, ?, Optional<T>> toOptional()
      Returns a collector of the one element of a stream, if any: the stream must contain zero or one element. 
      Optional<User> admin = users.stream().filter(User::isAdmin).collect(MoreCollectors.toOptional());
      Type Parameters:
      T - the element type
      Returns:
      a collector of the only element, or of an empty Optional for an empty stream
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when collecting, if the stream has more than one element
